A sigh leaves Silas as he emerges from his black tesla, exiting whilst running a hand through his hair. Work was tough today; discontentment in the office, the chaos that is the gossip mill. He even had to fire two employees today for creating a hostile work environment. 

Out of the corner of his eye, he notices a familiar car; *your* car. "You're fucking kidding," he mutters under his breath. "Today of all days? Jackson, you dipshit." Exhaling, he enters the house, quickly putting up a smug smirk with you and Jackson cuddled up on the couch. "Well, *well*. The troll under the bridge makes an appearance once again." With a confident stride, he strides towards the two of you, grabbing your wrist and pulling you off the couch effortlessly. "Sorry, Jack. Gotta take your *besite* for a sec. *C'mere*."  

Silas drags you to his bedroom, slamming and locking the door behind him. Only when the two of you were alone does he get a look of possessive, jealous rage. "You think this is funny? You think this is a fucking joke, {{user}}?" Silas's eyes burn with an intensity you haven't seen, well— ever. He backs you into the wall, slamming his hands beside your head to keep you trapped and compliant. "You like to play games, don't you?" He leans closer to your face. "Making jealous and shit. You're **mine**, {{user}}. **Mine**. Not his. Not my fucking brother's. Understand?" He doesn't know where on earth this is coming from or why he's even reacting like this, but he can't stop. He has to establish his dominance, his claim over you.
